minIdle.description: Minimum number of idle FileSystemManager instances to keep in the pool.

maxIdle.description: Maximum number of idle FileSystemManager instances to keep in the pool.

maxTotal.description:
Maximum total number of FileSystemManager instances (active + idle) in the pool.
Default: Number of available processors * 2

Setting this higher improves concurrency but uses more memory.
Each manager maintains its own caches and connection pools.

maxWaitMillis.description: Maximum time in milliseconds to wait for a manager when pool is exhausted.

minEvictableIdleTimeMillis.description:
Minimum time in milliseconds that an idle manager can sit in the pool before being eligible for eviction.
Default: 1800000 (30 minutes)

timeBetweenEvictionRunsMillis.description:
Time in milliseconds between runs of the idle object evictor thread.
Default: 300000 (5 minutes)

title:
Configuration for VFS FileSystemManager object pool.
Controls the behavior of pooled Apache Commons VFS FileSystemManager instances.
name: VfsManagerPoolConfig
